mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a group of words often without a finite verb of its own, and thus being unable to make a complete sense."
A phrase is a group of words often without a finite verb of its own, and thus being unable to make a complete sense.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to join many sentences without repeating an already mentioned noun."
Relative pronouns are used to join many sentences without repeating an already mentioned noun.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the verb and phrases in the sentences."
The grammatical elements underlined are the verb and phrases in the sentences.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the word that you add to the beginning of another word."
A prefix is the word that you add to the beginning of another word.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those used with pronominal verbs (S'habiller, Se reveiller, se laver, se lever)."
Reflexive Pronouns are those used with pronominal verbs (S'habiller, Se reveiller, se laver, se lever).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a group of grammatical elements comprising of adjectives or even nouns functioning as modifier in a sentence."
An adjectival phrase is a group of grammatical elements comprising of adjectives or even nouns functioning as modifier in a sentence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to describe physical or mental state that existed in the past such as this sentence."
The imperfect tense is used to describe physical or mental state that existed in the past such as this sentence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used after a preposition when the subject of the verb is "on"; "Chacun" or "personne"."
Soi as a pronoun is used after a preposition when the subject of the verb is "on"; "Chacun" or "personne".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one which returns the action of the verb to the doer (subject of the verb)."
A pronominal verb is the one which returns the action of the verb to the doer (subject of the verb).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered to be irregular when its stem (and even the endings in some other cases like infinitive faire, dire) changes from one person to another."
A verb is considered to be irregular when its stem (and even the endings in some other cases like infinitive faire, dire) changes from one person to another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to describe an action that was accomplished."
The simple past tense is used to describe an action that was accomplished.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used after a preposition as in these sentences."
Usually an emphatic pronoun is used after a preposition as in these sentences.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a clause that could stand on its own and would not need any other grammatical words or clause to complete its though so as to have a complete meaning, e.g."
An independent clause is a clause that could stand on its own and would not need any other grammatical words or clause to complete its though so as to have a complete meaning, e.g.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a grammatical word that can be used to replace a noun in a given sentence."
A pronoun is a grammatical word that can be used to replace a noun in a given sentence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used mostly to express two actions that are going on simultaneously."
The gerundive is used mostly to express two actions that are going on simultaneously.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to introduce an object or a thing to the listener while the definite article elaborates on the known or partier presented object / thing."
An indefinite article is used to introduce an object or a thing to the listener while the definite article elaborates on the known or partier presented object / thing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to riz-au-gras which is the antecedent and the object of the verb avait."
Que refers to riz-au-gras which is the antecedent and the object of the verb avait.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used before a noun starting with vowels or "h". example: l'animal,l‟ homme."
Note that l apostrophe is used before a noun starting with vowels or "h". example: l'animal,l‟ homme.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used with a verb before a comparative, before a noun with "de" and before the adverb plus, moins and trop."
Adverbs of quantity are used with a verb before a comparative, before a noun with "de" and before the adverb plus, moins and trop.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the first person, the one spoken to is the second person; and the one spoken of is the third person."
The speaker is called the first person, the one spoken to is the second person; and the one spoken of is the third person.

verb phrase

Reading

adjectival clause
An adjectival clause is a dependent clause used as an adjective in a sentence.

passage
The passage is composed with a mixture of plusperfect and imperfect tenses.

Remember a verb

declarative sentence
The declarative sentence is a type of sentence that is used to stae ideas.

nominal clause
A nominal clause is a dependent clause used as a noun in a sentence.
______ are the verb "faire" followed by another verb in the infinitive form: "vendre" and "rêver".
underlined words
The underlined words are the verb "faire" followed by another verb in the infinitive form: "vendre" and "rêver".

nominal group
A nominal group is a group of words acting as a noun.

Imparfait tense
Imparfait tense is the text includes: se rendait, traversait, dinait, avait".

subordinate clause
The subordinate clause is the secondary clause in a sentence.

adverb
An adverb is a part of speech which modifies a verb.

underlined sentence

______ is used after verbs that express a wish, necessity, will, preference and fear.
subjunctive mood

______ are used to emphasize the subject or the object in declarative or interrogative sentences.
emphatic pronouns

De la

______ are used to denote things either animate or inanimate, and the gender is purely coincidental.
Nouns
Nouns are used to denote things either animate or inanimate, and the gender is purely coincidental.
______ is used while giving an order or a directive sometimes, the infinitive may be used to give information and directives.
imperative
The imperative is used while giving an order or a directive sometimes, the infinitive may be used to give information and directives.
______ is the sentence where the simple past in used.
underlined expression
